    headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    payload = json.dumps({'user_chat': prompt})

    conn.request("POST", parsed_url.path or "/", body=payload, headers=headers)
    response = conn.getresponse()

    return {
      "output": response.read().decode()
    }
